Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.debug

Class HotReload

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.debug.HotReload
All Implemented Interfaces:
DebugFeature
public final class HotReload extends Object implements DebugFeature
The F5 debug feature: reads the data files again while the game runs (GDD 1.1.2). F5 only asks for a reload; it runs at the start of the next tick, so no tick ever sees half old and half new values. A file that fails is logged and kept as the last error, the other files are still read, and the game keeps running on the old values of that file.

Pattern: part of the data-driven engine; each Reloadable applies its own data.
